reason: I'd maybe download it for the free first summary and the free logging, but I'm not paying for a tracker when I already have Apple Health and my notes app. My doctor's going to do whatever she was going to do anyway.
objection: An app won't change what my doctor does. A nice one-page PDF doesn't mean she'll actually listen or change my meds, and I can write my questions down for free.
would_change_my_mind: If the free summary actually got my doctor to take me seriously and change something, like adjusting my metformin, I might pay the $7.99 once before the next appointment.
